sv.title: Jondetech i avtal med globalt teknikbolag – aktien rusar
sv.summary: Sensorbolaget Jondetech steg upp till 25 procent i den inledande handeln på tisdagen, efter nyheten att bolaget ingått avtal med ett globalt teknikbolag specialiserat på smarta hälsoringar, vilket Jondetech aviserade i ett pressmeddelande under morgonen.

en.title: Jondetech in deal with global tech company – shares soar
en.summary: Sensor company Jondetech rose as much as 25 percent in early trading on Tuesday, after news that the company has entered an agreement with a global tech company specialising in smart health rings, which Jondetech announced in a press release in the morning.
